page.overview:
Who is Ronald Jones?

Ronald "Ronnie" Jones was a character in , played by LL Cool J.

Ronald Jones was a security guard at Hillcrest Academy and an aspiring romantic novelist. He was married to Shirley Jones, with whom he had good relationship, although she did not support Ronnie's dream, because she felt it was going nowhere. Ronnie was on good terms with the students at Hillcrest, but he had some trouble with John Tate, the son of headmistress Keri Tate, as he was one of the few students who always tried to get Ronnie to let him out of the school. Ronnie had let John out before and, when the latter got caught, Keri told Ronnie that he would be fired if it happened again.

On October 31, 1998, John and his friend Charles Deveraux wanted to sneak off again, and Ronnie agreed on the terms that John and Charlie would be back before afternoon classes started. They were still caught by Keri and, once they returned, Ronnie tried to come up with an excuse, yet it appeared that Miss Tate did not believe him.

Later that night, Ronnie noticed that a car was parked outside the gate and decided to investigate. As he searched the car, finding no one there, Michael Myers slipped past him and walked onto the school grounds as Ronnie turned off the car engine. Ronnie tried to tell his wife that something strange was going on, but was interrupted by the car lights switching off, and decided to lock the back door of the security booth. As Ronnie tried to explain to his wife what was happening, Michael banged on a window of the booth and cut the phone lines, causing Ronnie to leave the booth to find out what was going on.
